result.instructions: Tools for PushPress, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many members checked in to classes last week?"; "Which classes are on the schedule tomorrow, and who is booked?"; "Find the customer with the email address jane@example.com and show her membership.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PushPress data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pushpress_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pushpress_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pushpress_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. pushpress_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pushpress_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get the gym (company) this API key belongs to: name, address and contact details. GET /company.

tools.name: pushpress_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List gym customers (members). Filter by email or role. Each customer has id, name, email, phone and membership details. GET /customers.

limit.description: Results per page (default set by PushPress).

tools.name: pushpress_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer by UUID: name, contact details, address, membership details and assigned staff. GET /customers/{uuid}.

uuid.description: Identifier (UUID or id) of the record.

tools.name: pushpress_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a new customer (member) with an email address and optional name, phone and date of birth. Writes a new record: check the details first. POST /customers.
